next.reason: Same. 1985: GENERATE data-name-1 performs detail processing and 'Normally' presents the designated detail. 2023 §2023:14.9.16.4 GR1 'Execution of a GENERATE data-name statement causes one instance of the specified detail to be printed, following any necessary control break and page fit processing'; §2023:13.18.57.4 GR5 and GR6 d) print a detail when a GENERATE references it. The 1985 'Normally' is SUPPRESS in a USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure, kept by §2023:14.9.45.4 GR3 a). No refusal or exception changes.
